sloka: अनुमन्यस्व माम् देवि गमिष्यन्तम् इतः वनम् ।शापिता असि मम प्राणैः कुरु स्वस्त्ययनानि मे ॥२-२१-४५॥
transliteration: anumanyasva mām devi gamiṣyantam itaḥ vanam ।śāpitā asi mama prāṇaiḥ kuru svastyayanāni me ॥2-21-45॥

translations.english: I have decided, O mother to go to the forest from here. Grant me the permission to do so. I swear on my life. Perform all the ceremonies for securing prosperity for me.
